text: This staff report is about a matter that the Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. This report responds to a request from Councillor Glenn De Baeremaeker to review the feasibility of installing higher level traffic calming devices on Benleigh Drive such as mid-block pinch points or a median.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Waived the requirement for a petition. 2. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to report to the January 2019 Scarborough Community Council meeting with a functional design proposal for pinch-points at the three intersections: Benleigh Drive and Benlight Crescent Benleigh Drive and Benadair Court Benleigh Drive and Benshire Drive.
